narrationTexts: Two real bugs, both from the options-shape change. Fixing both.
finalText:
**Build passes now, 0 errors.**

The screenful of `DEP0*` and `note:` lines was just noise from the bump. Two real bugs, same cause, both in the link stage:

- [src/core/options.js](src/core/options.js) read `options.retries`, but the new bundler passes `retryCount`. Threw on `.toFixed`.
- [src/net/retryPolicy.js](src/net/retryPolicy.js) threw when `backoffEnabled` was `undefined` instead of `false`, which the new config loader now returns for unset flags.

Fixed both. `node build.js` now exits 0 with 8 warnings, 0 errors.

Next: nothing.
